```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(DiffBind)
library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
library(ChIPseeker)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r cars}
#setwd("/Users/maxim/Documents/Diffbind_result")
```

##  WT D0 H3 vs WT D0 K4M 


```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
#setwd("/shared/home/hounani/DiffBind_result")
df_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3<-readRDS("DiffBind_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3.rds")
table_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3<-read.table("DiffBind_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3.tsv",header = TRUE)
dba.show(df_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3, bContrasts = TRUE)
df_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3
```

```{r}
diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3 <- dba.report(df_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3, th = 0.05, contrast = 1)
length(diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3)
head(diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3)
diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3 <- as.data.frame(diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3)
```

```{r}
class(diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3)
diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3 <- GenomicRanges::makeGRangesFromDataFrame(diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3)
```

```{r}
# annotate the peak
diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3 <- annotatePeak(diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3,
                          TxDb = TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene,  
                          annoDb = "org.Mm.eg.db",                     
                          tssRegion = c(-3000, 3000),                  
                          verbose = FALSE)
diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3 <- as.data.frame(diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3)
head(diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3)
```
```{r}
diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3$annotation<- str_replace(diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3$annotation, " \\s*\\([^\\)]+\\)", "")
table(diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3$annotation)

```

```{r}
diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3$Fold<- table_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3$Fold
diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3$FDR<- table_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3$FDR

```

```{r}
pdf("Volcanoplot_ATAC/volcano_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
dba.plotVolcano(df_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3, contrast=1) 
dev.off()

```
```{r}
dba.plotMA(df_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3, contrast = 1 )

```
```{r}
ggplot(diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3, aes(x = annotation, y = Fold))+
  geom_boxplot()
```


```{r}
D0_WT_K4M_enrich <- diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05 & Fold > 0) %>% 
  dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end)
# Write to file
write.table(D0_WT_K4M_enrich, file="bed_files/D0_WT_K4M_enriched_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3.bed", sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=F)

D0_WT_H3_enrich <- diff_peaks_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05 & Fold < 0) %>% 
  dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end)

# Write to file
write.table(D0_WT_H3_enrich, file="bed_files/D0_WT_H3_enriched_D0_WT_K4M_vs_D0_WT_H3.bed", sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=F)
```


```{r}
cat("number of D0 WT K4M enriched peaks :", nrow(D0_WT_K4M_enrich),"\n")
cat("number of D0 WT H3 enriched peaks :", nrow(D0_WT_H3_enrich))

```
